description: PROPOSED (Discussion #49, alternative B: declared aggregation), NOT in the spec on main. The same q2 row as altb_partial_result_undeclared_rejected.json, now declaring on the Result that `passed` is the spec default `all` over the scored graders, plus the `partial` aggregation_status (a second value next to Rule 6's `unscored`, meaning some but not all graders have score null). A reader can now tell that `passed: true` rests on one grader with the other not verified. The dotted spelling of the reserved key is used here; the nested spelling (`metadata.openeval.aggregation`) is equivalent.
